crossRefs.note: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body, and shed out his…
His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
Now he who betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”
Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”
